runSummary.stalePolicy: LIVE eligibility requires real source verification and link evidence. Content age and source-verification age are separate; touching updatedAt alone never makes a job fresh.
runSummary.note: Fresh 12.9.2026 09:54 sweep across 12 source families. No promotion-grade unique LIVE item was added. The strongest fresh local delta was PROPLUSCO Back Office Asistent/ka, Bratislava, 4-hour part-time, 700 EUR gross: direct company detail confirms broad back-office/personnel administration and no explicit foreign-language requirement, but compensation is supplementary rather than main-income level, so it remains a verification/stacking candidate instead of an automatic LIVE promotion. Henkel International Team Assistant is BA-local but requires C1 English and 2+ years executive-assistant experience. Facebook public indexing yielded 0 verifiable hiring posts.

developmentChanges.title: Stackable part-time effective-day value
developmentChanges.reason: For 4-hour/part-time BA roles, calculate guaranteed monthly pay, commute cost and occupied day-window together so a low nominal salary is not rejected if it can be efficiently stacked with another job, and weak half-day roles do not crowd out better full-time options.

developmentChanges.title: Mirror-to-primary source upgrade queue
developmentChanges.reason: When Profesia or Práca za rohom exposes a fresh role and a direct employer detail also exists, automatically queue the direct source for canonical verification and keep only one stable job identity. This improves source trust and prevents mirrors from inflating diversity counts.
